title: The Parish of Saint Alder's
author: Noor Sandoval
blurb: Mara Villalobos, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the statute expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
